Allah accepts the repentance of those who do wrong in ignorance and repent soon after, not of those who repent only when death comes or die as disbelievers.
Whoever does wrong or wrongs himself and then seeks Allah's forgiveness will find Him Forgiving and Merciful; a sin is earned only against oneself.
Others admitted their sins, having mixed good and bad deeds; the Prophet takes charity to purify them, Allah accepts repentance and sees all deeds, and some await His decision.
Seek forgiveness and repent to the Lord for good provision for a set term; those who turn away are warned of a great Day, and all return to Allah.
Your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful to those who do wrong out of ignorance, then repent and reform.
Later generations neglected prayer and followed desires and will meet evil, except those who repent, believe and do righteousness, who will enter Paradise unwronged.
Turn to your Lord and submit before punishment comes suddenly, lest a soul regret its neglect, blame its lack of guidance or wish for another turn after denying His verses.
Believers are told to repent sincerely so Allah may remove their misdeeds and admit them to gardens, their light running before them as they ask Him to perfect it.
